text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, with the spring GⅠ season right around the corner—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ――UOOOOOAAAAAHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ââPhew!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, how was that!
My running is in peak condition, ain't it!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: What a razor-sharp finish...! How confident are you heading into the upcoming Oka Sho?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: No matter who I'm up against, I'm definitely gonna win!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"...So something like that!
Please give it an eye-catching headline!"

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: (Oooooh...--)

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
—Fans are already whispering about high hopes
for the Triple Tiara. What are your thoughts on that?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Ah, well, that's...—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOH!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: —Heheh.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Just keep your eyes on my running!!
...Guess that about sums it up!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: —I look forward to working with you today.

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
"What a gorgeous racing dress with such beautiful blue tones...!
It carries such elegance, it suits you wonderfully!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much!
I'm so happy to hear you say that.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Wearing this racing outfit, I swear I'll take first place at the Oka Sho...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter D
text_block_list.text: Your biggest rival at the moment seems to be Vodka, whom you recently competed against in the Tulip Sho, but—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...You're right.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'll admit... I lost last time.
However, I will definitely not concede the Oka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Who is the strongest,
and who does the tiara suit best—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I shall prove it to you.

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: (Oooooh...--)

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Race fans have been buzzing about the Classic-class Tiara circuit
in this year's Twinkle Series...!

text_block_list.name: Commentator A
text_block_list.text: Led by Vodka, who won the Hanshin JF in record time, so many talented Umamusume have gathered here...!

text_block_list.name: Commentator A
text_block_list.text:
A little while back, people used to say that
'Umamusume on the Classic Triple Crown route
are stronger than those on the Triple Tiara route,' but—

text_block_list.name: Commentator A
text_block_list.text: "Perhaps that common belief is starting to become outdated."

text_block_list.name: Commentator A
text_block_list.text:
"The strong Umamusume are the ones who win"...
Lately, I've come to feel that such an era is truly arriving.

text_block_list.name: Commentator B
text_block_list.text:
"The Umamusume on the Tiara route lately
really stand out for their physical strength in races too."

text_block_list.name: Commentator B
text_block_list.text: The racing fans seem to feel the shift as well, looking forward to the dawn of a new era.

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text: "The Twinkle Series might have even more exciting developments in store for us from here on out—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Lately, the media has been paying
an enormous amount of attention to the Triple Tiara route.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's not as if the Classic Triple Crown route isn't
getting attention, but you can't deny
feeling a bit of a difference in enthusiasm...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —Generally speaking, I am of the same opinion.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: In today's Twinkle Series, the rigid boundaries between traditional racing paths of the past are starting to blur...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, it makes it easier to gather Umamusume
whose physical conditioning is already well-developed
by their Classic year.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
What that means...
you understand better than anyone, Trainer.
choice_data_list: ...Things tend to work out at a disadvantage for you.
...It's easy for things to work against you.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
That's right.
...Hearing you say that with such certainty puts me at ease.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Dream Journey was naturally
a petite Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even with an increase in muscle mass from Awakening,
compared to an Umamusume with a naturally larger build,
a difference in power is inevitably bound to occur.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In a race, that difference will create
a great deal of tactical limitations.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The tougher the race becomes, including the weather,
the harder a battle Dream Journey
will be forced to fight.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Of course, physical capability is by no means
the end-all and be-all in racing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Looking back through history,
there have certainly been petite Umamusume who achieved great success—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Even if races with stark physical disparities await down the road, I cannot afford to flinch."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To ensure Dream Journey achieves even greater success
than past Umamusume, I just have to do my job to the fullest...!
choice_data_list: ...Let's go over the Satsuki Sho once more.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Assess the situation harshly, and adapt flexibly.
That must be what is required of me on this journey with Dream Journey.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...That is very reassuring.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, on that day, we finalized our strategy for the final adjustments leading up to the Satsuki Sho—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...――

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Phew...—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Elder Sister.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Oh, Orfe—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Did you come all the way out here for me?
The nights are still quite chilly, you know."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Flawless, huh.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Thanks to you.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Still, things didn't go as planned.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Oh, dear me...—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Are you still worried about us?
...About who we are?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Do your best to prove it to me, then.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Yeah, let's do that.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: "...As your older sister, I will do my utmost to deliver results you can be proud of."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Use everything you've got.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Heading toward the first leg of the Classic Triple Crown, the Satsuki Sho.
The traveler's steps proceed solemnly—
